entries.notes: REPLACE: what the site's robots.txt permits for User-agent *. Name the paths it disallows and confirm none of the files captured here falls under one.
REPLACE: the genre list. 18-external-contracts records eight genres plus an `all` pseudo-entry; confirm the count and note which selector carries the container.
REPLACE: genre listing page 1. Note the row count you count BY HAND and the selector that finds it.
REPLACE: page 2 of the same listing. Confirm it lists DIFFERENT novels than page 0 -- if the two are the same, pagination is not real and B9 cannot be tested.
REPLACE: any novel's page. Note whether the chapter table publishes its own count -- Royal Road does, and that is what makes B9 checkable.

REPLACE: one chapter body. RECORD THE CONTAINER CLASS EXACTLY, including any second class on the same element -- on Royal Road it is `chapter-inner chapter-content`, and an exact match on `chapter-content` finds nothing.
REPLACE: the shortest chapter you can find, ideally under E18's 100-character threshold, so 'too short to read' is distinguishable from 'empty'.
